_comment: Release gates (ADR-006 §Release gates). All must PASS to publish. --gate evaluates the applicable rows against a run's receipt; --report-only downgrades a failing run to a non-zero-free advisory (used in CI until the native binding + full datasets are wired). A gate whose precondition does not apply to the run (a link-prediction gate on the synthetic suite; ANN/adversarial without their flags; transfer without --baseline-receipt) is SKIP, never a silent pass. Every threshold carries a `source`; numbers are REPRODUCED baselines minus a stated margin, never invented.

link_prediction_fb15k237.source: LibKGE README ComplEx FB15k-237 filtered MRR 0.348 − 3pp margin (ADR-006); RANDOM tie-break
link_prediction_fb15k237.description: Filtered test MRR on FB15k-237 within 3pp of the reproduced LibKGE ComplEx baseline.

link_prediction_wn18rr.source: LibKGE README ComplEx WN18RR filtered MRR 0.475 − 3pp margin (ADR-006); RANDOM tie-break
link_prediction_wn18rr.description: Filtered test MRR on WN18RR within 3pp of the reproduced LibKGE ComplEx baseline.

tie_break_random.source: Sun et al. 2020 arXiv:1911.03903; ADR-003 §5 / ADR-006 §protocol 2
tie_break_random.description: An all-tied scorer must give mean rank ≈ (|E|+1)/2 under RANDOM (not 1=TOP, not |E|=BOTTOM). SKIP if the binding cannot produce a constant scorer.

hole_complex_equiv.reason: asserted by the ruvector-kge-core Rust unit test (both forms agree on random params to fp tolerance); it is a precondition for trusting the HolE gate number and is not JS-measurable here
hole_complex_equiv.description: HolE ≡ ComplEx equivalence — verified in the crate test suite, reported here as an external precondition.

ann_recall10.source: ADR-006 §Release gates ANN recall floor (derived Q5 claim, measured); Budgeted MIPS arXiv:1610.03317
ann_recall10.description: recall@10 of the DotProduct-HNSW + exact-rerank pipeline vs exhaustive scoring; SKIP without --ann.

adversarial_confidence_drop.description: Mean confidence on targeted facts must DROP under the symmetry-decoy attack (the alarm is exercised); SKIP without --adversarial.

loop_safety_transfer.source: ADR-004 gate 3 (no transfer-split regression beyond 1 point)
loop_safety_transfer.description: Transfer-split MRR must not regress beyond 1 point vs the --baseline-receipt; SKIP without one.

latency_predict_p95.source: ADR-006 §protocol 7; thresholds set from bench/fft-spike-2026-09-21.json (native batch score+build ≈2.3ms at d=512/2000 entities; 50ms p95 leaves headroom to FB15k-237 scale). wasm32 is compile-only in the spike, so its threshold stays pending.
latency_predict_p95.description: Predict p95 (from --ann) must be ≤ the native threshold once the ADR-002 spike exists. SKIP without the spike file, without a predict-latency measurement, or on a non-native backend (wasm threshold pending).
